templates.title: ReplayHaven
templates.description: Self-hosted game clip archive. A Windows client names every clip with a local AI; this server keeps the originals and streams them to your devices.
templates.note: Source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial): free for personal use. Create the access key with openssl rand -hex 24; after the first start, the container log shows a setup link for your account. The server needs no GPU; the AI runs on the gaming PC.

env.name: REPLAYHAVEN_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.label: Access key (at least 24 characters)
env.description: Needed once to create the first account, e.g. from openssl rand -hex 24.

env.name: REPLAYHAVEN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
env.label: Server address as opened in the browser
env.description: Protocol, host and port exactly as you open ReplayHaven.
